title: The Locals — photo-to-3D character harness
note: The Locals' reel (Nov 16, 2026): a single front image becomes a perspective-correct, structured 3D character. She sent it asking how they built a harness around the AI. Findings: the reel shows no tools or UI; their site makes characters from a phone-camera capture, with Accepted creation treatment suggesting human curation. The documented pipeline pattern (from videogame.io): photo check, 4-panel character sheet, TRELLIS mesh, rig, validator + render — the shape of the harness, not their exact code, since The Locals publishes no stack. Saved into the Photo to 3D character harness side chat.
